// Positive-control fixture: the persisted-shape registry from PR #3815's
// rework-before diff (packages/daemon/src/schema-migration-review.ts at
// origin/task_95e4e53e388b83bcb2bb7f68ed, commit fefc8e9bf). The review lane
// routes on this checkout's directories, so a consumer repository can never
// hit it. tools/check-self-repo-path-literals.test.mjs writes this file into a
// temp checkout and requires every directory prefix to be reported.
const persistedShapeSurfacePrefixes = [
  "packages/kernel/src/domain/",
  "packages/kernel/src/schemas/",
  "packages/kernel/src/store/",
  "packages/kernel/src/projection/",
  "packages/storage/src/store/",
  "packages/storage/src/projection/",
  "packages/preset/src/",
  "packages/preset/assets/",
] as const;

export function persistedShapeSurfaceHits(deliverables: readonly string[]) {
  return deliverables.filter((target) =>
    persistedShapeSurfacePrefixes.some((prefix) => target.startsWith(prefix)),
  );
}
